banner.title: Test it yourself: prevention, screening and the safety net
banner.text: Start with the whole family: one Family Health Passport for three generations across five hospitals. Then well-child visits, adult IFHAS screening and emergencies at home. Enter your own data, see Noa’s agents find the barrier or the risk, and follow it to care and to the Department of Health. Or press “Run it for me”.
